answer.reason: Option B (249,530,741 MWh) corresponds to Florida's total statewide net generation, which is on the order of ~250 million MWh per year — far too large to be a single sector line like IPP & CHP. Therefore, Table 1 lists IPP & CHP net generation as 16,588,495 megawatthours.
